name: Chuck
description: When Buy More computer geek Chuck Bartowski unwittingly downloads a database of government information and deadly fighting skills into his head, he becomes the CIA's most vital secret. This sets Chuck on a path to become a full-fledged spy.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Third Dimension (2D)
videos.overview: Chuck foils a plan to kill Tyler Martin, an international rock star. Chuck's night out with Tyler leads to trouble. Morgan holds a contest among his fellow employees. 2D version of the Episode originally aired in 3D

videos.title: Buy More #15: Employee Health
videos.overview: John Casey explains how to rid the Buy More of unwanted pests.

videos.title: Buy More #17: Leadership
videos.overview: Even Big Mike knows that sometimes a manager has to look the other way.

videos.title: Buy More #7: Customer Service
videos.overview: At the Nerd Herd service desk, not all occupational hazards are unwelcome.

videos.title: Buy More #24: Youth Marketing
videos.overview: Young or old, loyal customers are created by great sales associates, like Morgan Grimes.

videos.title: Buy More #14: Work Ethic
videos.overview: Emmett's secrets for Buy More career success: show up early and keep your eyes and ears open.

videos.title: Buy Hard - The Jeff and Lester Story - Episode 1
videos.overview: Jeff and Lester adjust to living life on the lam.

videos.title: Buy Hard - The Jeff and Lester Story - Episode 2
videos.overview: Jeff and Lester arrive at the Encino Buy More for the release of Halo: Reach.

videos.title: Buy Hard - The Jeff and Lester Story - Episode 3
videos.overview: Along with Big Mike, Jeff and Lester come up with a plan to get the game.

videos.title: Buy Hard - The Jeff and Lester Story - Episode 4
videos.overview: Jeff, Lester and Big Mike infiltrate the Encino Buy More.

videos.title: Buy Hard - The Jeff and Lester Story - Episode 5
videos.overview: Jeff, Lester and Big Mike make their final attempt to get Halo: Reach.

videos.title: EW Reunions: #UnitedAtHome
videos.overview: The show's stars Zachary Levi, Yvonne Strahovski, Adam Baldwin, Joshua Gomez, Sarah Lancaster, Ryan McPartlin, Vik Sahay, Scott Krinsky, and Mark Christopher Lawrence, gathered on Zoom, along with co-creators Josh Schwartz and Chris Fedak to reminisce about their time on the series. They also performed a table read of the script for "Chuck Versus the Beard," episode 9 from the show's third season. The episode was hand-picked by fans on social media after a call-out by EW and Levi himself to help us decide which script to revisit.

videos.title: Meet the Nerd Herders
videos.overview: A  six part web series that takes a look at "The Nerd Herd Team" who work at the Buy More.

videos.title: Morgan's Vlog
videos.overview: While Chuck is away on a 3 month spy trip, Morgan maintains a diary which explains how movies can be made better.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Intersect
videos.overview: Chuck’s normal life is turned upside down when a mysterious email from an old friend loads stolen government secrets into his brain, putting him in the middle of a CIA and NSA operation.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Helicopter
videos.overview: The government sends in its top scientist to extract the intersect from Chuck’s brain, but explosive events leave him unsure whether he can trust Casey or Sarah.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Tango
videos.overview: Two daring missions: foil a vicious arms merchant… and nail down the assistant manager spot at the Buy More.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Wookiee
videos.overview: A visiting agent stirs tension around Sarah’s past, pushing Chuck and Sarah’s relationship into awkward new territory.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Sizzling Shrimp
videos.overview: After his intuition is wrong while working on a stakeout, Chuck gets drawn into a rescue mission involving the triads. Morgan must participate in a sales competition that could decide his fate at Buy More.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Sandworm
videos.overview: On Halloween, Chuck’s attempt to juggle his spy life, a Buy More promotion, and his friendship with Morgan is complicated by an encounter with a brilliant government inventor on the run.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Alma Mater
videos.overview: Chuck must confront his painful past when a mission forces him to return to Stanford, the university that wrongfully expelled him.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Truth
videos.overview: A mercenary wielding a toxic truth serum puts Ellie in danger, thwarting a family dinner party and Chuck’s attempt at a normal romance.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Imported Hard Salami
videos.overview: Chuck's new romance with Lou takes a dangerous turn when her deli imports are linked to a black-market smuggling ring.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Nemesis
videos.overview: After the unexpected return of an old friend, Chuck learns that a renegade group within the CIA is after the Intersect - which Chuck has to balance with the year's busiest shopping day at the Buy More.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Crown Vic
videos.overview: While acting as a married couple for a high-society sting operation, Chuck and Sarah must stop a corrupt billionaire’s counterfeiting operation - which sees Morgan and Anna in the cross hairs.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Undercover Lover
videos.overview: A mission targeting a Russian smuggling ring takes a deeply personal turn when Casey's secret romantic past is unexpectedly brought to light.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Marlin
videos.overview: When a hostile spy bug at the Buy More threatens to expose Chuck as the human Intersect, the team faces a frantic race against time before the government locks him in an underground bunker forever.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the First Date
videos.overview: As the completion of a new Intersect computer promises to end his spy days forever, Chuck prepares to ask Sarah out on a real first date.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Seduction
videos.overview: To recover a stolen database component, Chuck must go undercover and learn the art of seduction from a legendary, yet washed-up spy.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Break-Up
videos.overview: A high-stakes undercover heist forces Chuck and Sarah to confront their complicated relationship boundaries when a familiar face resurfaces to lead the mission.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Cougars
videos.overview: Chuck goes undercover at Sarah's 10-year high school reunion, where they meet the girl who tortured Sarah back in the old days.

videos.title: Chuck Versus Tom Sawyer
videos.overview: Chuck must get close to eccentric co-worker Jeff, an arcade champion whose memories hold the key to stopping a rogue satellite weapon. Big Mike introduces a corporate efficiency expert to the Buy More.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Ex
videos.overview: On a routine Nerd Herd call, Chuck runs into his ex-girlfriend Jill. After flashing on her research-scientist boss, he must get close to Jill to investigate their potential ties to a dangerous corporate bioweapon.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Fat Lady
videos.overview: Chuck must uncover a conspiracy hidden inside Jill’s pharmaceutical company while keeping his spy life secret from her. The Buy More staff attempt to sabotage Emmett's corporate efficiency test to save their jobs.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Gravitron
videos.overview: Chuck tries to enjoy a romantic date at a local carnival with Jill, but the night quickly spirals into a dangerous pursuit. Ellie stresses over hosting the perfect Thanksgiving dinner for Devon’s parents, and Morgan, Jeff, and Lester are forced to guard the Buy More over the holiday.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Sensei
videos.overview: Casey is forced to confront his past when his former sensei turns rogue and steals a high-tech global tracking device from a hidden facility. Devon’s overly enthusiastic parents arrive to help with wedding planning.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the DeLorean
videos.overview: Sarah's estranged con-artist father arrives in town, forcing Team Bartowski to help him pull off a real estate scam against a dangerous sheik with terrorist ties. Anna pressures Morgan to buy an apartment together, but he makes an impulse buy instead.

videos.title: Chuck Versus Santa Claus
videos.overview: A high-stakes hostage situation unfolds at the Buy More on Christmas Eve when an amateur criminal crashes his car into the store - holding Chuck, his family and friends inside at gunpoint.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Third Dimension
videos.overview: When Chuck's accidental heroics foil a hit on an international rock star, he is forced to babysit the unpredictable musician to uncover who wants him dead. Big Mike goes on a fishing trip, leaving a power-tripping Emmett in charge of the Buy More.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Suburbs
videos.overview: Chuck and Sarah move into a picturesque suburban cul-de-sac as an undercover married couple, giving Chuck a taste of a normal life with Sarah while they investigate a hidden Fulcrum hub.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Best Friend
videos.overview: Chuck is ordered to spy on Anna's wealthy new boyfriend after a flash reveals his ties to a dangerous triad gang. To protect Morgan from getting caught in the crossfire, Chuck must secretly intervene before his heartbroken best friend gets hurt.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Beefcake
videos.overview: Following advice from Ellie, Chuck makes a decision about his and Sarah’s "cover" relationship. But he becomes jealous when Sarah has to seduce a handsome enemy agent. Jeff and Lester turn an interview process into a personal swimsuit and talent pageant to crown the "Buy More Babe".

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Lethal Weapon
videos.overview: The team joins forces with a charming British MI6 agent to track down a rogue scientist who holds the key to the Intersect. Morgan tries to convince Anna that moving in with him would be a bad idea.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Predator
videos.overview: Chuck goes rogue when he is contacted by Orion, the reclusive mastermind behind the original Intersect computer who claims he can remove it from Chuck’s brain. The Buy More rises to a challenge from a rival branch.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Broken Heart
videos.overview: Beckman sends a strict inspector to evaluate Sarah's performance after a mission goes awry. With his usual team dynamic under threat, Chuck must work with the ruthless new agent to infiltrate the hospital - at Devon’s expense.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Dream Job
videos.overview: An interview at Roark Instruments was once Chuck's dream, but the opportunity is actually a spy cover to thwart a hidden virus. While navigating the corporate world, he must balance the mission with a personal quest to find his father.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the First Kill
videos.overview: Chuck must reluctantly team up with his ex-girlfriend Jill to carry out a high-stakes rescue mission. To pull off the operation, he is forced to navigate their complicated past while keeping their objective on track.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Colonel
videos.overview: When Chuck and Sarah go AWOL on a rogue mission, Casey has orders to track down his partners - dead or alive. A power-tripping Emmett takes full control of the Buy More.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Ring
videos.overview: On the day of Ellie and Awesome’s wedding, a sudden threat puts the big day in jeopardy. Chuck must risk everything to protect his family and permanently secure his freedom from the Intersect before the ceremony begins.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Pink Slip
videos.overview: Chuck struggles to get his life back on track after a grueling spy training program ends in failure. Dropped from the government payroll, he must find a way to rebuild his confidence and reunite with his former partners when a new threat emerges.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Three Words
videos.overview: Chuck gets a new mission when Carina returns with her fiancé Karl. While navigating her unpredictable presence, Chuck struggles to mend his strained professional partnership with Sarah.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Angel de la Muerte
videos.overview: Awesome accidentally gets pulled into a high-stakes mission when a visiting dictator is targeted for assassination. Chuck must navigate a tense political standoff to protect his brother-in-law while Casey faces an unexpected blast from his own past.

videos.title: Chuck Versus Operation Awesome
videos.overview: When Awesome is mistaken for a super spy, Chuck must become his handler and show him the ropes. While on a mission for The Ring, they meet the mysterious Daniel Shaw. Meanwhile, Morgan gets promoted to assistant manager and must deal with Jeff and Lester's latest hijinks.

videos.title: Chuck Versus First Class
videos.overview: Daniel Shaw assigns Chuck to his first solo mission in Paris, ignoring Sarah and Casey’s wishes. During the flight, Chuck befriends Hannah and flashes on another passenger. Casey helps Morgan battle Jeff and Lester for control of the Buy More.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Nacho Sampler
videos.overview: Chuck juggles his two lives as he trains new Nerd Herder Hannah and gets his very own asset who is caught up with The Ring. Awesome must lie to Ellie when she starts to ask questions about Chuck.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Mask
videos.overview: Chuck and Hannah unexpectedly become part of Shaw's latest mission to steal a mask from an art exhibition. Morgan and Ellie continue their mission to get to the bottom of Chuck's secretive behavior.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Fake Name
videos.overview: Chuck must juggle his new relationship with Hannah while at the same time assuming the identity of notorious assassin Rafe Gruber for a mission.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Beard
videos.overview: Chuck feels like his life is falling apart when he can't flash and gets left behind for a mission. While Shaw, Sarah and Casey go on without him, Chuck finds himself in a sticky situation back at the base.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Tic Tac
videos.overview: Casey carries out a side mission for his old commanding officer that leads to him committing treason. When Chuck learns the truth, he and Sarah set out to break Casey out of jail and clear his name.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Final Exam
videos.overview: Chuck must complete a solo assassination mission to finally graduate into a full-fledged, official CIA agent. Sarah and Casey secretly shadow his assignment, deeply worried about how taking a human life will fundamentally change who he is.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the American Hero
videos.overview: Chuck has his pick of the best CIA agents for an undercover operation, but he has only one in mind for the job. Casey, Morgan and Awesome team up to help Chuck convince them to join him, while a Ring operative remains on the loose.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Other Guy
videos.overview: Chuck, Sarah and Shaw travel to Paris on a high-stakes mission to track down the remaining leadership of the Ring. However, the operation turns deadly when explosive secrets about the past are revealed, forcing Chuck to make a devastating choice.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Honeymooners
videos.overview: On a train ride through Europe, Chuck and Sarah decide to run away and leave the spy life behind forever. However, their peaceful escape is quickly derailed when they discover a high-profile international smuggler is hiding in the very same train car.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Role Models
videos.overview: Chuck and Sarah are assigned to train under Craig and Laura Turner, a married CIA team who hate one another. Their stormy relationship forces Chuck and Sarah to wonder if they're doomed to the same fate.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Tooth
videos.overview: Chuck struggles with disturbing dreams - and his most recent one predicts danger for a visiting head of state. Beckman is unconvinced and sends Chuck to meet with a CIA psychiatrist.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Living Dead
videos.overview: As vivid, Intersect-fueled dreams begin to malfunction and take a dangerous physical toll on his brain, Chuck enlists Morgan’s help to determine if an old enemy is still alive. The stakes escalate when Chuck's estranged father returns, growing instantly suspicious of his son's continued involvement with the CIA.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Subway
videos.overview: As the Intersect continues to malfunction, the CIA officially strips Chuck of his spy status. Forced onto the defensive, he must rely on an unexpected family alliance to expose the corrupt officials pulling the strings before his loved ones pay the price.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Ring: Part 2
videos.overview: Team Bartowski launches a desperate operation to stop a conspiracy from destroying the CIA. To save his family, Chuck must push his malfunctioning Intersect to its absolute limits.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Anniversary
videos.overview: Chuck and Morgan launch a secret mission across the globe to track down Chuck's missing mother. Meanwhile, Sarah and Casey travel to Russia to infiltrate a dangerous weapon-dealing conglomerate known as Volkoff Industries.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Suitcase
videos.overview: An undercover mission in Milan to seize a high-tech weapon from a dangerous supermodel forces Chuck to confront a major vulnerability in his relationship with Sarah.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Cubic Z
videos.overview: Chuck and Sarah's romantic mission is canceled with the return of Hugo Panzer and Heather Chandler. But Chuck grows more interested when the manipulative Heather claims to know a secret about his mom. Morgan prepares the Buy More for a huge video game release.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Coup d'Etat
videos.overview: Chuck and Sarah try to become better communicators as they join Ellie and Awesome on a trip to Costa Gravas. A forbidden romance may put Morgan at odds with Casey.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Couch Lock
videos.overview: When Casey's former team returns looking for him, Chuck must decide what he's willing to sacrifice in order to find his mom. Morgan works up the nerve to reveal a secret to Casey.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Aisle of Terror
videos.overview: On Halloween, the team must stop Dr. Stanley from releasing a toxin that induces nightmares. The allegiances of Chuck’s mom are called into question.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the First Fight
videos.overview: After their first real fight, Chuck avoids confronting Sarah by going on a rogue mission that leads him to his mom's MI-6 handler and a mysterious Russian agent. Ellie is on her own mission to uncover the Bartowski family's long-buried past.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Fear of Death
videos.overview: Afraid that his latest setback is driving a wedge between him and Sarah, Chuck resolves to prove himself by going on a dangerous mission with the overeager Agent Rye. Morgan and Casey scramble as the "Buy Morons" attempt to uncover the true identity of Greta.

videos.title: Chuck Versus Phase Three
videos.overview: Chuck, Sarah, Casey and Morgan venture into the jungles of Southeast Asia when The Belgian attempts to unravel the secrets of the Intersect. Awesome and Ellie try to decipher a secret left behind by her father.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Leftovers
videos.overview: It's the day after Thanksgiving and Chuck faces the most awkward of family reunions when mom comes over for dinner—along with the dangerous Alexei Volkoff. At the Buy More, Morgan deals with the busiest shopping day of the year as Jeff and Lester hatch their latest scheme.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Balcony
videos.overview: Chuck tries to create the perfect romantic getaway while tracking down a nano-chip at a French vineyard. Lester asks Big Mike for love advice.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Gobbler
videos.overview: Sarah is given the task of breaking Volkoff’s top bodyguard, Yuri the Gobbler, out of a maximum-security prison. Ellie and Awesome are at odds over what to name the baby.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Push Mix
videos.overview: The mission to take down Volkoff reaches a dangerous new level, while big changes loom at home. As Sarah works to free Chuck’s mom, Chuck and Morgan embark on their own mission to take down Alexei Volkoff. Meanwhile, Casey bonds with his daughter, Alex, while Ellie tries to ease Awesome’s anxieties over fatherhood.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Seduction Impossible
videos.overview: Casey, Chuck and Sarah are sent to Morocco to rescue Roan Montgomery. Morgan plans to meet Alex's mother and Mary spends some time with her family.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Cat Squad
videos.overview: Chuck surprises Sarah with her old spy team, the C.A.T. squad, leading to a mission in Rio. As they work to settle a score, old secrets and grudges come to light. Morgan fends off the advances of Carina, a former flame and frisky member of the C.A.T. squad.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Masquerade
videos.overview: Valentine's Day is interrupted when Chuck and the team are sent on a mission to England to protect a reclusive young heiress, Vivian McArthur. Meanwhile, Casey gets an offer from the mysterious Jane Bentley. Back at home, Ellie and Awesome find an unlikely solution to a parenting problem, as Morgan ponders a big move.

videos.title: Chuck Versus The First Bank of Evil
videos.overview: Chuck encourages Vivian to get in touch with her inner villain for a mission. Morgan's search for a new roommate has unexpected results.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the A-Team
videos.overview: Chuck and Sarah suspect Casey is carrying out private missions. Chuck fears the CIA's new operatives will render him obsolete. Morgan settles in with a new roommate. Awesome becomes uncomfortable with Ellie's research.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Muuurder
videos.overview: Chuck is put in charge of a top-priority mission, but his leadership skills are pushed to the limit when there is a murder in Castle. Awesome takes on a mission of his own when Ellie finds an alarming new hobby. Morgan's leadership is tested when his Buy More troops wage war against Large Mart.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Family Volkoff
videos.overview: With the help of his old nemesis Alexei Volkoff, Chuck and the team hunt down a deadly weapon, the Norseman. Sarah springs a surprise on Chuck.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Wedding Planner
videos.overview: When Chuck and Sarah get conned out of their savings, there is only one man they can turn to for help – Sarah's conman father, Jack Burton. Morgan pressures Casey to face Alex's mother.

videos.title: Chuck Versus Agent X
videos.overview: Chuck and Sarah put aside spy work to have a weekend of debauchery, but Awesome’s plans for Chuck’s big night don’t go quite as expected. Meanwhile, Ellie's investigation into her father's computer leads to a life-changing discovery.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Last Details
videos.overview: Chuck’s wedding prep includes one final detail: ensuring that the mother-of-the-groom makes it to the ceremony alive. Meanwhile, Morgan’s responsibilities as Best Man include his most dangerous mission yet, as he faces Vivian Volkoff. Elsewhere, Ellie tends to the last details of the rehearsal dinner and seeks help from an unlikely source.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Cliffhanger
videos.overview: Before he can kiss the bride, Chuck must enlist his wedding party to take down Vivian Volkoff and stop her from destroying the big day. When he turns to Alexei Volkoff for help, the CIA sends its toughest agent, Clyde Decker, to stop them.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Zoom
videos.overview: Without the Intersect or the support of the CIA, the world of espionage is a much more dangerous place for Chuck and his team of freelance spies. Carmichael Industries takes on a slick, rich thief and a conniving investor who has stolen money from some of the world's most dangerous people. Morgan helps Chuck with a special surprise for Sarah. In the Buy More, Jeff and Lester have taken things to another level with their latest scheme.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Bearded Bandit
videos.overview: As the team takes on a missing persons case, Chuck and company struggle to establish themselves as Carmichael Industries in the face of a rival security firm led by the tough and efficient Gertrude Verbanski. Morgan continues to adjust to his new role while Chuck adjusts to being his handler. The Buy More finds an unlikely spokesperson to help drum up business.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Frosted Tips
videos.overview: As the team is tasked with finding one of the CIAs most wanted, Chuck fears that the Intersect may be going to Morgan's head. Meanwhile Sarah helps Casey navigate his relationship with Gertrude. Elsewhere, Captain Awesome makes a startling revelation about Jeff and Lester.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Business Trip
videos.overview: Chuck and Sarah track an assassin who is trying to eliminate the new Intersect. Jeff exposes a new side of himself.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Hack Off
videos.overview: Chuck turns to Verbanski for help tracking a computer virus. Jeff and Lester's relationship is complicated by a new Buy More employee.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Curse
videos.overview: Chuck and Sarah must race against time and ruthless spy Robyn Cunnings to destroy a dangerous computer virus. Ellie and Awesome’s date night takes a dangerous turn and Morgan is sent on a special mission to recover Chuck's P.A.N.T.S.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Santa Suit
videos.overview: Chuck and Sarah learn who is trying to destroy Carmichael Industries. Ellie's Christmas plans come undone. A computer virus threatens to ruin Christmas at Buy More.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Baby
videos.overview: Sarah is forced to confront a secret from her past and feels she must do so alone, while Chuck urges her to let him help. When Sarah encounters her original handler, Kieran Ryker, she fears that he will harm those closest to her, including her mom.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Kept Man
videos.overview: While Chuck and Sarah contemplate the next step for Carmichael Industries, Casey’s forbidden love Verbanski walks back into his life with a questionable mission. Jeff and Lester suspect that something unusual may be happening at the Buy More.

videos.title: Chuck Versus Bo
videos.overview: As Chuck and Sarah try to realize a new, safer future, Morgan’s past as the Intersect sends them to Vail on one last mission, where they enlist the help of an unlikely source — the legendary Bo Derek. Elsewhere, Jeff and Lester continue their own spy mission.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Bullet Train
videos.overview: When a mission in Japan becomes a hostage situation, Sarah and Chuck must face the merciless Nicholas Quinn aboard a speeding Japanese bullet train. Meanwhile, the mission leaves Casey with an impossible decision.

videos.title: Chuck Versus Sarah
videos.overview: After a harrowing mission, Sarah returns to Chuck with a huge secret. Meanwhile, Ellie and Awesome are presented with a new opportunity that could change their lives.

videos.title: Chuck Versus the Goodbye
videos.overview: Chuck enlists his family, friends and some unexpected allies as he races to stop Nicholas Quinn from destroying everything Chuck has built over the past five years.

awards: Won 2 Primetime Emmys. 9 wins & 34 nominations total
